main_text.p: אלק Ch. Deus. Sic sæpè scribunt פ אלהא superstitiosè, ne sc.si nomen integrè scriptum esset, ac liber non satis mundè aut sanctè tractaretur, injuria fieret nomini divino.
אלקפתא Chal. Secundus à Rege, Vice-Rex, Genef.41. 44. in Targ.Jon.
אלש אלוש Ch. Nomen proprium loci, Num. 16. 26. Jon.
אמה אמהו, אמתא, אמהה Ch. & Syr. Ancilla. Plur. אמהן, אמהתא Ancillæ.
אמט אמטתא Ch. Caligo, obscuritas, tenebræ densæ, maximæ. Resp. Hebr. עלמה.
אמל אמלין Ch. Chlamydes, Togæ, Ezech. 27.24. Kimchius scribit, se nullibi præterea legisse.
אמם אם, אמא Ch. & Syr. Mater. מן ומן Mater matris, id est, Avia, 2.ad Timoth.1.5. Plural. אמהן, emph. אמהתא Matres. אמן Cantic.8.5. forte pro אמא.
אמה, אמתא Chal. & Syr. Cubitus, Mensura cubitalis. Plur. אמין, אמיא Ezech.43.13.
אום, אומא, אמא Ch.& Syr.Natio,gens,populus. Plur. אומין, אומיא, Syr. ܐܘܡܐ.
אמן ܐܡܢ, Unde formam habet ܐܡܢ. Vide in מאן. Aphel הימין Chald. ܐܡܢ Syr. Credere, concredere, Fidem habere, ܐܡܢ ܐܡܢ Concredita est mihi, 1.ad Cor.9.17. Ethpah. ܐܬܐܡܢ

page.notes: Hebrew, Aramaic/Syriac and Greek-free text transcribed as printed; the Syriac and Hebrew forms in the Chaldee and Syriac entries are only approximately legible and may contain errors. Several Hebrew words in the entries are rendered from the scan with [?] omitted for brevity; the Syriac words after "Syr." and "Ethpah." are doubtful.
